card.name: The g ending "mcg" after a number
card.fires_on: The final letter g in the microgram unit written as "mc" + "g", right after a number, as in 9.9 mcg/mL or 25 mcg/L. It appears in dose tables and concentration limits.

modes.label: Concentration units
modes.description: The g of mcg before a slash and a volume unit, such as /mL or /L.
modes.example: <9.9 mc<<g>>/mL If symptoms are not controlled and current

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: The g of mcg in a plain dose amount or per-kg rate.

card.plain: It fires on the last letter of "mcg" (micrograms) when it follows a number in a dose or concentration.
